description:
Report the progress of a publish: the build status, the deploy events since after_event_id (queued, built, uploaded, domain wiring, completed or failed), whether it is done, and the live URL.

Call it after publish_build or publish_post, passing the build and after_event_id they returned, and keep calling it with the returned after_event_id until done is true. With after_event_id, only a deploy event after it ends the wait: a site rebuild after a post change is queued (up to about 3 minutes unless the account is Pro+) and reports waiting_for_start until it begins. It waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, max 45) per call, sending progress notifications meanwhile. possibly_stuck flags a publish with no events for far longer than a deploy takes.

When it reports success: Right after deployment.completed the URL can still serve the previous version for up to a minute while Cloudflare's edge caches refresh, and page paths redirect (308) to a trailing slash, so fetch with redirects followed (curl -L). Read-only; it never starts or cancels a deploy.

after_event_id.description: Only report events after this id: pass publish_build's after_event_id, then the after_event_id this tool returned on the previous call. Omit it to see the build's whole event history; completion is then judged from the build status alone.

build.description: The build being published (publish_build returns it as "id:<id>"). Defaults to the project's active build.

project.description: Which project: its uuid, its numeric id, its micropage hostname ("acme" or "acme.micropage.sh") or its custom domain ("www.acme.com"). A full URL also works. Get valid values from list_projects.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the deploy to finish before returning, 0-45 (default 20). 0 returns a snapshot at once.

name: get_deploy_status

done.description: True when the publish finished (deployed or failed). With after_event_id only a deploy event after it counts; without, true also when the build is simply not publishing.

events.description: New events since after_event_id, oldest first.

type.description: e.g. build.enqueued, deployment.started, deployment.domain_wiring, deployment.completed, build.failed.

events_truncated.description: True when older events were left out to keep the reply short.

possibly_stuck.description: True when the build has been publishing with no deploy events for much longer than a deploy takes.

succeeded.description: True when deployed, false when failed, null while still running.

waiting_for_start.description: True when after_event_id was given but the deploy has not started yet: a site rebuild after a post change is queued (up to about 3 minutes unless the account is Pro+) and only then shows events.

title: Follow a micropage deploy
